Extensive experience with UNICEF and UN agencies as a key client
Proven track record in refugee, displacement and protection programming across East Africa
Deep presence in Somalia and experience in fragile/conflict-affected states
Established capacity in community engagement and participatory approaches
MEL expertise with advanced tools (KoboToolbox, SPSS, NVivo) for monitoring child protection outcomes
Arabic language capability enabling direct engagement in Sudan

key_gaps:
Sudan is secondary geographic focus; primary presence in Somalia/Kenya/Ethiopia rather than Sudan
No specific mention of child protection programming expertise in Cortech profile
CSO applicants are typically local/national NGOs; Cortech is regional consultancy firm (structural misalignment)
Limited evidence of integrated lifesaving child protection service delivery implementation
No track record cited specifically for explosive ordnance awareness or birth registration programming

Document provides minimal detail on selection criteria, evaluation framework, or proposal specifications—suggesting pool establishment model requiring CSO-specific governance and local registration
